verses.en: The transgression of the wicked saith within my heart, that there is no fear of God before his eyes.
verses.pt: A transgressão fala ao ímpio no íntimo do seu coração; não há temor de Deus perante os seus olhos.
verses.en_web: An inner sanctuary is within my heart about the disobedience of the wicked: “There is no fear of God before his eyes.”
verses.en_bbe: <To the chief music-maker. Of the servant of the Lord. Of David.> The sin of the evil-doer says in his heart, There is no fear of the Lord before his eyes.

verses.en: For he flattereth himself in his own eyes, until his iniquity be found to be hateful.
verses.pt: Porque em seus próprios olhos se lisonjeia, cuidando que a sua iniqüidade não será descoberta e detestada.
verses.en_web: For he flatters himself in his own eyes, too much to detect and hate his sin.
verses.en_bbe: For he takes comfort in the thought that his sin will not be uncovered and hated.

verses.en: The words of his mouth are iniquity and deceit: he hath left off to be wise, and to do good.
verses.pt: As palavras da sua boca são malícia e engano; deixou de ser prudente e de fazer o bem.
verses.en_web: The words of his mouth are iniquity and deceit. He has ceased to be wise and to do good.
verses.en_bbe: In the words of his mouth are evil and deceit; he has given up being wise and doing good.

verses.en: He deviseth mischief upon his bed; he setteth himself in a way that is not good; he abhorreth not evil.
verses.pt: Maquina o mal na sua cama; põe-se em caminho que não é bom; não odeia o mal.
verses.en_web: He plots iniquity on his bed. He sets himself in a way that is not good. He doesn’t abhor evil.
verses.en_bbe: He gives thought to evil on his bed; he takes a way which is not good; he is not a hater of evil.

verses.en: Thy mercy, O LORD, is in the heavens; and thy faithfulness reacheth unto the clouds.
verses.pt: A tua benignidade, Senhor, chega até os céus, e a tua fidelidade até as nuvens.
verses.en_web: Your loving kindness, Yahweh, is in the heavens. Your faithfulness reaches to the skies.
verses.en_bbe: Your mercy, O Lord, is in the heavens, and your strong purpose is as high as the clouds.

verses.en: Thy righteousness is like the great mountains; thy judgments are a great deep: O LORD, thou preservest man and beast.
verses.pt: A tua justiça é como os montes de Deus, os teus juízos são como o abismo profundo. Tu, Senhor, preservas os homens e os animais.
verses.en_web: Your righteousness is like the mountains of God. Your judgments are like a great deep. Yahweh, you preserve man and animal.
verses.en_bbe: Your righteousness is like the mountains of God; your judging is like the great deep; O Lord, you give life to man and beast.

verses.en: How excellent is thy lovingkindness, O God! therefore the children of men put their trust under the shadow of thy wings.
verses.pt: Quão preciosa é, ó Deus, a tua benignidade! Os filhos dos homens se refugiam à sombra das tuas asas.
verses.en_web: How precious is your loving kindness, God! The children of men take refuge under the shadow of your wings.
verses.en_bbe: How good is your loving mercy, O God! the children of men take cover under the shade of your wings.

verses.en: They shall be abundantly satisfied with the fatness of thy house; and thou shalt make them drink of the river of thy pleasures.
verses.pt: Eles se fartarão da gordura da tua casa, e os farás beber da corrente das tuas delícias;
verses.en_web: They shall be abundantly satisfied with the abundance of your house. You will make them drink of the river of your pleasures.
verses.en_bbe: The delights of your house will be showered on them; you will give them drink from the river of your pleasures.

verses.en: For with thee is the fountain of life: in thy light shall we see light.
verses.pt: pois em ti está o manancial da vida; na tua luz vemos a luz.
verses.en_web: For with you is the spring of life. In your light shall we see light.
verses.en_bbe: For with you is the fountain of life: in your light we will see light.

verses.en: O continue thy lovingkindness unto them that know thee; and thy righteousness to the upright in heart.
verses.pt: Continua a tua benignidade aos que te conhecem, e a tua justiça aos retos de coração.
verses.en_web: Oh continue your loving kindness to those who know you, your righteousness to the upright in heart.
verses.en_bbe: O let there be no end to your loving mercy to those who have knowledge of you, or of your righteousness to the upright in heart.

verses.en: Let not the foot of pride come against me, and let not the hand of the wicked remove me.
verses.pt: Não venha sobre mim o pé da soberba, e não me mova a mão dos ímpios.
verses.en_web: Don’t let the foot of pride come against me. Don’t let the hand of the wicked drive me away.
verses.en_bbe: Let not the foot of pride come against me, or the hand of the evil-doers put me out of my place.

verses.en: There are the workers of iniquity fallen: they are cast down, and shall not be able to rise.
verses.pt: Ali caídos estão os que praticavam a iniqüidade; estão derrubados, e não se podem levantar.
verses.en_web: There the workers of iniquity are fallen. They are thrust down, and shall not be able to rise.
verses.en_bbe: There the workers of evil have come down: they have been made low, and will not be lifted up.
